entries.rationale: Exact direct-end-customer-selling predicate retained.
“Acquire” narrowed to responsibility for winning customers or new logos; prospecting alone cannot satisfy it.
Existing-account ownership consolidated with duplicate relationship and lifecycle questions.
Managing or growing channel partners is the same ongoing indirect-network responsibility.
Indirect-network recruitment predicates have the same channel-build/recruit consequence.
Partner onboarding, activation, enablement, training, and certification share the enablement domain.
Co-selling and joint opportunity or pipeline development share one channel-depth domain.
Distributor, dealer, and indirect-network management consolidated with other ongoing channel management.
Alliance and ecosystem relationship management has the same ongoing indirect-network consequence.
Customer-success ownership and adoption/value-realization responsibility route differently.
Retention and renewals share the same bounded post-sale growth tier.
Upsell, cross-sell, and account expansion share the same bounded post-sale growth tier.
Old compound crossed discovery, solution design, demos, POC scoping, and POC execution.
Marketing, sponsorship, influencer, and brand partnerships have one generic-partnership consequence.
Demand generation, lead generation, and campaign execution share one route.
Forecasting narrowed to forecasting operations; owned forecast delivery remains separately sourced by S2.CML.Q32.
Customer, partner, and internal-seller enablement have different consequences.
Onboarding, implementation, deployment, and customer launch share the same lifecycle tier.
Ongoing support, service, and issue resolution share the same post-sale tier.
Exact commercial-terms negotiation predicate retained.
“Primary” adds no separate tier; explicit ongoing account ownership supplies the needed fact.
Account relationship ownership and portfolio/book scope are distinct facts.
Prospect relationship-building alone supplies no approved tier and proves neither discovery, qualification, nor acquisition.
Maintaining customer relationships after sale is ongoing account responsibility.
Executive contact does not establish executive advice, influence, or decision authority.
Generic business-stakeholder relationship management has no distinct approved route.
Managing a technical stakeholder relationship does not establish technical work or authority.
Procurement, legal, finance, or commercial contact has no distinct approved route.
Ongoing channel or reseller relationships are the same indirect-network management fact.
Distributor, dealer, or agent relationships are the same indirect-network management fact.
Strategic-alliance and ecosystem relationships are the same ongoing indirect-network fact.
Technology, implementation, and service-partner relationships are not necessarily channel work and have no separate tier.
Coordinating multiple stakeholder groups within one account is stakeholder coordination.
Trusted-advisor wording has no unique approved route and proves neither ownership nor technical/executive advice.
Relationship escalation responsibility consolidates with ongoing support and issue resolution.
Voice-of-customer or partner representation is the same internal-representation predicate.
Coordinating customer relationships with internal sales/account teams supplies stakeholder coordination.
Coordination across product, engineering, support, implementation, or service teams supplies the same tier.
Creator, influencer, sponsor, and brand-partner relationships are the same generic-partnership motion.
Recurring internal relationships are ordinary collaboration and do not establish leadership or influence.
Segmentation or account planning has no distinct approved tier.
Lead and demand generation are already represented by the same predicate and consequence.
Exact direct-outbound-prospecting predicate retained.

Demos, evaluations, POC scoping, and POC execution are distinct facts.
